title: The Town Mouse and the Country Mouse
description: A country mouse visits his sophisticated cousin in town and discovers that luxury is not much fun when dinner comes with danger.
catalogueBlurb: Two cousins discover that a peaceful meal can beat a grand feast.
author: Aesop, told anew by Joseph Jacobs
